text: A compact invariant set is hyperbolic when its tangent bundle splits as E^s (+) E^u with:
choices: uniform contraction on E^s and uniform expansion on E^u
all Lyapunov exponents equal to zero
explanation: Hyperbolicity is uniform contraction in the stable direction and expansion in the unstable direction. Zero exponents or equal/rotating subspaces describe non-hyperbolic (e.g. elliptic) behaviour.
